AcquisitionAuth.description:
Declares one request header whose value is read from an environment variable.

The job names the variable; the secret itself is never part of the policy.
AcquisitionAuth.title: AcquisitionAuth

AcquisitionPolicy.description: An exact host allowlist asserts the caller's permission to acquire a source.
AcquisitionPolicy.title: AcquisitionPolicy

AfterObservation.description: Datetimes of ``field`` must not lie before the observation time (minus tolerance).
AfterObservation.title: AfterObservation

CommandProvider.description:
A local model command run without a shell; the prompt goes to stdin.

The command may forward page content to a hosted service, so it needs either
``allow_remote = true`` or ``local = true``. ``env`` lists extra variable names
passed through besides ``PATH`` and ``HOME``. Arguments may be empty strings; the
program (the first item) may not.
CommandProvider.title: CommandProvider

CssRecipe.description: Select HTML records with ``record_selector``; fields end in ::text or ::attr(name).
CssRecipe.title: CssRecipe

DatasetSpec.description: Where approved records of a job would be stored and which fields identify a record.
DatasetSpec.title: DatasetSpec

DistinctRatio.description: Distinct values of ``field`` over record count must not fall below ``min_ratio``.
DistinctRatio.title: DistinctRatio

EgressProfile.description: One administrator-declared HTTP(S) proxy. Credentials are environment references.
EgressProfile.title: EgressProfile

EmbeddedJsonRecipe.description:
Read JSON embedded in HTML: ``source`` selects one node, then ``record_path`` and fields
work as in ``JsonRecipe``.

``source`` is a CSS selector ending in ``::attr(name)`` (``input[name=GXState]::attr(value)``)
or ``::text`` (``script#__NEXT_DATA__::text``); it must match exactly one node.
EmbeddedJsonRecipe.title: EmbeddedJsonRecipe

FileJobSource.description: Local HTML or JSON file source resolved within the job file's directory by default.
FileJobSource.title: FileJobSource

HistoricalShift.description:
Median of ``field`` must not shift more than ``max_shift`` versus dataset history.

``unit = "days"`` compares datetimes; ``unit = "ratio"`` compares numbers as
``|current - history| / |history|``.
HistoricalShift.title: HistoricalShift

InferencePolicy.description: Per-extraction budgets; concurrency is shared by one Rastro instance/event loop.
InferencePolicy.title: InferencePolicy

JsonLdRecipe.description:
Map JSON-LD objects, optionally of one or several ``item_type`` values, with pointers.

``item_type`` is one type or 1..8 types; an object matches when any of its ``@type``
values is listed. A field maps to one pointer or to 1..4 pointers; the first that
resolves wins.
JsonLdRecipe.title: JsonLdRecipe

JsonRecipe.description: Select JSON records at ``record_path``; fields are pointers relative to each record.
JsonRecipe.title: JsonRecipe

OllamaProvider.description: Local Ollama model configuration; never accepts remote hosts or inline secrets.
OllamaProvider.title: OllamaProvider

OpenAICompatibleProvider.description:
Chat Completions model configuration; credentials are env variable names only.

``provider = "http"`` is the documented name; ``"openai_compatible"`` stays accepted.
OpenAICompatibleProvider.title: OpenAICompatibleProvider

Pagination.description: A bounded next-page expression, interpreted by the recipe strategy.
Pagination.title: Pagination

RecipeContext.description: Caller-managed template, region and custom-validator revision identifiers.
RecipeContext.title: RecipeContext

RegionalContext.description: Explicit regional settings applied to sources unless overridden per source.
RegionalContext.title: RegionalContext

RepairPolicy.description: Automatic promotion requires explicit opt-in and every measured gate.
RepairPolicy.title: RepairPolicy

ScheduleSpec.description: Optional `[schedule]` block in a job file (`every` and bounded `jitter`).
ScheduleSpec.title: ScheduleSpec

ScrollSpec.description:
Scroll a rendered page until a step finds no new records, or a cap is reached.

Scroll applies to ``render = "browser"``. It never enables stealth or challenge solving.
HTTP sources ignore it and say so (``scroll_ignored_http``); so do stealth sources
(``scroll_unsupported_stealth``): Scrapling keeps the page pooled, but Rastro does not
drive scroll in it. Both stay successful runs.
ScrollSpec.title: ScrollSpec

SpiderPolicy.description: The job's ``[spider]`` table. ``mode = "list"`` (the default) is today's behaviour.
SpiderPolicy.title: SpiderPolicy

UrlJobSource.description: Permitted HTTP(S) job source; its host must appear in acquisition.allowed_hosts.
UrlJobSource.title: UrlJobSource

description: Declarative extraction job (`format_version = 1`). Pure data; never executes code.
title: Job
